review_repository.description: Legacy single-repository checkout. Prefer repositories.<alias>.checkout. REVIEW_PR_REPO overrides the selected checkout.

default_repository.description: Alias selected when the command receives only a PR number, for example review-pr 123.

profiles.description: Reusable repository profiles. Repository-level skills override profile skills.

repositories.description: Configured GitHub repositories and their dedicated local review checkouts.

reviews_directory.description: Absolute directory outside the selected review checkout where review artifacts are stored. Defaults to $HOME/review-pr when omitted. REVIEW_PR_OUTPUT_DIR overrides this value.

language.description: Global output language for every review stage. Stage-specific entries under languages override this value.

model.description: Model override used only by the configured synthesizer during final synthesis.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort override used only by the configured synthesizer during final synthesis. Omit to inherit agents.<synthesizer>.effort; set an empty string to disable inherited effort. Supported values depend on the synthesizer and model.

language.description: Legacy final-synthesis language. Prefer the global language field or languages.final. Classification values and P0–P3 severity values remain fixed.

languages.description: Optional per-stage overrides of the global language. An empty string explicitly inherits the global value.

reporting.description: Controls machine-readable finding contracts and optional comparison sections.

finding_contract.description: Versioned machine-readable finding contract. Markdown remains the default; ndjson-v1 is opt-in per implemented phase.

cross_review.description: Structured cross-review requires primary=ndjson-v1 and comparison_sections.cross_review=none.

final.description: Structured final synthesis requires primary and cross_review ndjson-v1, and comparison_sections.final set to none or standalone.

dispute_resolution.description: Emit and validate opt-in resolution records for cross-review disagreements in the final ndjson-v1 stream. Requires finding_contract.final = ndjson-v1.

execute_measurements.description: Run the allow-listed, read-only, shell-free commands proposed by resolution records inside the review checkout and attach the captured result to the resolutions sidecar. Requires dispute_resolution = true. Artifact-only final reruns skip execution.

include_comparison_sections.description: Legacy all-or-nothing switch. True maps both stages to inline; false maps both stages to none. Prefer comparison_sections.

cross_review.description: Whether each cross-review omits or embeds the extended comparison block.

final.description: Whether final synthesis omits, embeds, or generates the extended comparison block as a separate report.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of reviewer processes running at once in primary and cross-review phases. Omit for unlimited concurrency.

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts per agent in each primary and cross-review phase, including the initial attempt.

delay_seconds.description: Delay before starting a failed-only retry round.

additionalProperties.description: Optional skill name as known by the target agent. An empty string explicitly disables an inherited profile skill; no filesystem path is required or validated.

github.description: GitHub owner/repository slug used for PR metadata and context requests.

checkout.description: Absolute path to the dedicated Git checkout for this repository.

skills.description: Per-repository agent skill-name overrides. These take precedence over profile skills.

enabled.description: Set false to keep this agent's configuration but exclude it from primary and cross-review. The configured synthesizer must remain enabled.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. Built-in Claude and Codex agents support their documented values; custom runners receive the resolved value in REVIEW_PR_EFFORT.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time for one agent attempt in any phase. Zero or omission disables the timeout. Timed-out attempts fail with exit status 124 and follow the normal failed-only retry policy.

max_tool_calls.description: Pi only. Enables the orchestrator's Pi tool guard extension for tool-enabled phases: identical tool calls never execute twice, and after this many executed calls every further call is blocked and the model must return its output. Zero keeps the duplicate guard with no budget. Omit to run Pi without the guard.

command.description: Generic non-shell command adapter. The first item is the executable; remaining items are literal arguments. It receives the orchestration prompt on stdin and must return only Markdown on stdout from a disposable worktree at the PR head. It is mutually exclusive with runner. Exact placeholder arguments {{prompt_file}}, {{repository}}, {{model}}, {{effort}}, {{phase}}, {{pr_number}}, {{base_ref}}, {{head_ref}}, {{base_sha}}, and {{head_sha}} are expanded safely.
